support_claim: The registry row associates ID 4721193 with MERIDIAN ENERGY PARTNERS LLC and billing records list Meridian Energy Partners LLC, but no observation links the billing referent to that registry identifier.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY requires evidence establishing that both referents denote the same legal counterparty; name correspondence across separate sources is insufficient. DISTINCT requires evidence of distinctness, which the packet does not provide. With neither burden met, UNRESOLVED is the licensed disposition.
